title: Stage questions: STATUS: question, /away, and /continue @ticket
description:
Per the map ticket 'Delegate skills' (harness-0sx.12, Asks); CONTEXT.md (Stage result, Question, Parked, Away).

A Stage may write a Stage result 'STATUS: question' followed by the question and its options, then wait in its session. It asks only what the Ticket, the approved Plan, the repo's docs and the Inputs do not already answer; otherwise it notes the answer it took from them. The Stage skills' 'Nobody is watching this pane: do not ask questions' gives way to this rule; the headless calls (the audit, the Debate sides) cannot ask, and their briefs say decide and note. Before the Plan is approved plan mode cannot write the Result file: an open question goes into the Plan, and the plan review answers it.

The Orchestrator reads STATUS: question as neither done nor a Wake, and the Judgment never answers it. Present: a Question with the Stage's question and its options, plus an answer of your own, open the pane, and park; the answer goes into the pane as a prompt and the session carries on, later overwriting the Result file with done or failed. The Stage timeout pauses while a question waits. Questions are never saved: on resume a Result file still reading STATUS: question, its session live, raises the Question again.

Away: /away (in Ticket 4's command table) toggles it, again to turn it off; shown on the status row; off each time the Shell opens. While Away a Stage's question parks its Ticket: a bd comment on the Ticket says it needs a manual resume (bd comments add), the Shell says 'parked: asked you while away', and the pane stays open. Turning Away on parks the Stage questions already waiting. Judgments still answer what they can.

/continue @ticket, a new optional argument, also during a live run (then as a command to the scheduler, as /retry is for a Parked Ticket): unparks that one Ticket at its Stage, watching its live session, and puts its question first; a gone pane is reopened by its session id (Ticket 13). Without the argument /continue is as today.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: The result parser takes STATUS: question and its text. Fake world: a question raises a Question with its options; the answer is sent to the pane by herdr agent prompt; the deadline does not fire while it waits; a later done result completes the Stage; no Judgment is ever called on a question. With Away on the Ticket parks, the fake bd sees the comment, the Shell says 'parked: asked you while away', and the pane is not closed; /away on with a question waiting parks it; /continue @ticket in a live run unparks it and raises its question first.
